content: Table.TABREF32 describes the performance of our baselines on the answer sentence selection task. The No-answer (NA) baseline performs at 28 F1, providing a lower bound on performance at this task. We observe that our best-performing baseline, Bert + Unanswerable achieves an F1 of 39.8. This suggest that bert is capable of making some progress towards answering questions in this difficult domain, while still leaving considerable headroom for improvement to reach human performance. Bert + Unanswerable performance suggests that incorporating information about answerability can help in this difficult domain. We examine this challenging phenomena of unanswerability further in Section .
